name: Twin Palms Resort
note: Older fishing-and-hunting park on SR-78 near Lakeport, about 2 mi from Lake Okeechobee and across the highway from the rim canal. All RV sites are back-in, with 50/30/20-amp full hookups ($50/night, 2026); bar, showers, cabins. Park models and long-stay units fill the south half; the transient row backs onto the pond. Also bookable on Hipcamp. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Online booking via ResNexus (operator's booking page, linked from its Google listing) and a live, bookable Hipcamp listing (status LIVE, isBookable true, checked 2026-10-02); RV site $50/night, all back-in, 50/30/20A full hookups, read by AWH 2026-10-02 (passes the <=$50 published-rate gate); Google 4.2 over 74 (quality signal for a Good-Sam-only park); Campendium lists max RV 45 ft, open year-round, no age restriction
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 220 m frame) at 27.0068,-81.0530: a row of ~10 RV sites backs directly onto the south bank of a ~130x80 m pond, with an open, unused grass apron of ~5-15 m between the pads and the water and no treeline or road between them - pond. The rim canal south of SR-78 is across the highway (not counted)
